info.title: DC motor startup and load
info.question: Why does motor current fall as speed rises?
info.expected: Current starts at zero through armature inductance, rises during startup, then back EMF reduces it as the rotor accelerates.
info.try: Select MTR1 to vary mechanical load live. Lock the rotor in startup settings and Restart to measure stall current.
info.limitation: Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load. No brushes, commutation ripple, thermal model, gearbox or hardware ratings.
